reasoning: The Fed has been reducing its MBS holdings through quantitative tightening (QT) since 2022, allowing securities to mature without reinvestment. This policy has been consistent, with MBS holdings declining steadily week-over-week. As of October 2026, there's no indication QT would have ended. The Fed typically doesn't actively purchase MBS during tightening cycles. Week-to-week increases are rare and would require a policy reversal or unusual circumstances. Given the established trend of declining MBS holdings, an increase over this one-week period is highly unlikely.
